quarterly_data.quarter: Equinix press release: Equinix Accelerates AI Inference for Enterprises with (09-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Equinix announced Equinix Inference Exchange, a distributed AI inference program for enterprises that combines NVIDIA's Enterprise Reference Architectures, Together AI's inference platform (supporting more than 200 open-source models) and Equinix's global data centers, connected through Equinix Fabric - a significant expansion of its collaboration with NVIDIA and a new collaboration with Together AI. Equinix provides power, advanced cooling and day-two operations; Together AI runs the platform on top (multitenant and dedicated single-tenant). Equinix Inference Exchange will be available starting in Q1 2027. The release states Equinix has more than 280 data centers across 77 metros, 230 cloud on-ramps and over 10,500 businesses interconnected, and that eight of the top 10 AI model providers and nine of the top 10 AI clouds are deployed with Equinix.
quarterly_data.figure: Inference Exchange available starting Q1 2027; more than 280 data centers in 77 metros
